name: a-resize-carries-the-sidebar-contents-with-it
description:
The page holds the width the native side pushes rather than laying out at 100%, so that a collapse slides the sidebar out instead of re-flowing the favourites and the rows on every tick. Only the commit pushed it. A drag moved the slot and left the page at the pre-drag width, so the contents sat in a pane that was no longer that wide - narrower than it, or overflowing it - and stayed that way until the next Cmd+S.

The reading is the page's own: the sidebar element's width against the viewport it lives in. Equal means aligned, whatever the number is, so the assertion does not care what the drag settled on.

Docked here rather than floating. Both paths now push, and the docked one is the one a screenshot cannot argue with - the panel's own width is harder to read from outside than the pane's.

DOCKED ONLY. The reveal half lived here and could not be made to run: the chord that collapses the pane does not land after a synthetic drag on a loaded machine, so the pane stayed docked and every reading after it measured the wrong thing. the-floating-sidebar-resizes-by-its-edge covers the panel, and AtriumSidebarOverlayBrowserTest.ThePagesOwnHandleResizesThePanelAndCommitsTheWidth covers the width a reveal opens at.

actions.expression: (() => { const bar = document.querySelector('.spacedots'); const dots = bar ? [...bar.querySelectorAll('.sdot')] : []; if (!dots.length) return 'no dots'; const row = bar.getBoundingClientRect(); const a = dots[0].getBoundingClientRect(); const b = dots[dots.length - 1].getBoundingClientRect(); return Math.round((a.left + b.right) / 2 - (row.left + row.width / 2)); })()
actions.note: how far the chips sit from the middle of their row. The .sdot chips only: the row also holds an absolutely-positioned glow whose rect follows the active dot, and including it measures the glow rather than the layout.

assertions.label: the-contents-still-fill-the-pane-after-a-resize
assertions.desc: The page lays out at the width the native side pushes. Pushed only on commit, a drag left this at the difference between the pre-drag width and the new pane.

assertions.label: the-space-dots-sit-in-the-middle
assertions.desc: Measured against the row rather than a pixel, so it holds at any width the drag lands on.

assertions.label: the-drag-actually-resized-something
